specialties.name: Cross-Examiner
specialties.power: Before Witnesses scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Witnesses.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Witnesses Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Evidence Specialist
specialties.power: Before Evidence scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Evidence.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Evidence Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Expert Coordinator
specialties.power: Before Experts scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Experts.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Experts Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Bench Advocate
specialties.power: Before Judge scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Judge.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Judge Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Jury Advocate
specialties.power: Before Jury scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Jury.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Jury Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Appellate Scholar
specialties.power: Before Case Law scores, place 1 of your Firm markers in Case Law.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Case Law Lead Credits.

specialties.name: Trial Lawyer
specialties.power: When you resolve a Case card in Witnesses or Jury, place 1 additional Firm marker of your color in the chosen Issue.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 1 Witnesses and 1 Jury Lead Credit.

specialties.name: Technical Litigator
specialties.power: When you resolve a Case card in Evidence or Experts, place 1 additional Firm marker of your color in the chosen Issue.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 1 Evidence and 1 Experts Lead Credit.

specialties.name: Motion Counsel
specialties.power: When you resolve a Case card in Judge or Case Law, place 1 additional Firm marker of your color in the chosen Issue.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 1 Judge and 1 Case Law Lead Credit.

specialties.name: Generalist
specialties.power: When you resolve a Case card, choose any Issue instead of an eligible printed Issue. Resolve the same action type. On a Focus card, first choose Lead or Co-Counsel, then choose any Issue.
specialties.bonus: Your Lead Credits show at least 3 different Issues.

specialties.name: Team Builder
specialties.power: When you resolve Co-Counsel, place 1 additional Joint Work marker in that Issue.
specialties.bonus: Both firms on your side have at least 17 Reputation before Specialty bonuses.

specialties.name: Closer
specialties.power: After Closing Argument cards are revealed, move up to 2 of your Firm markers from unrevealed Issues to one revealed Issue.
specialties.bonus: Hold at least 2 Closing Argument Lead Credits.
